vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar: ✦ You're ready for your job advancement to %s! Go to the Order temple in Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.knuffelridder: New: the Nest Form of Wahoog Flomp!
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.pluisjager.4: New: the Nest Form of Star Shot!
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.vadsmagier.4: New: the Nest Form of Meteor Guh!
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.knuffelridde: Double Smack: Pillow Bonk swings once more after a second (60 % damage). Plus Defense and Strength.
Paladin Aura: you and your group within 10 blocks heal 1.5 % Chonk every 2 s. Plus 120 Chonk and Heal Power.
Crystal Wall: while your Snuggle Shield is up, every enemy that hits you freezes for 3 s. Pillow Bonk deals 40 % more damage to frozen enemies. Plus Strength, Defense and Chonk.
Nest Form: Wahoog Flomp becomes a pillow with wings. 30 % more damage, and the wind pulls all enemies within 8 blocks to the center (not bosses). Plus Strength, Defense and Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.1: Flip Volley: in the middle of your Roll Flip you shoot 3 arrows at the nearest enemy. Plus Dexterity and Move Speed.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.2: Falcon Gaze: your arrows curve a little toward enemies. Plus 8 % crit and 15 % crit damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.3: Ice Star: every 5th normal shot that hits fires an ice star along with it (1x weapon damage, 2 s Frozen). Star Shot freezes everything it pierces for 4 s. Plus Dexterity and Crit.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.pluisjager.4: Nest Form: Star Shot deals 40 % more damage and pierces shields: a quarter of the damage goes straight through them on top. Plus Dexterity, Crit Damage and Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.1: Element Puddle: Pink Fireball leaves a puddle of its element for 3 s that deals damage. Plus Wisdom and Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.2: Chonk Overflow: every 3rd skill costs no energy. Plus 10 % Cooldown Reduction and 8 % Element Damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.3: Mirror Echo: Pink Fireball freezes for 1.5 s. If it hits an enemy that was already frozen, the ice shatters in a second explosion (1.2x weapon damage, radius 3). Plus Wisdom and Element Damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.vadsmagier.4: Nest Form: Meteor Guh leaves a pink fire field for 5 s (radius 3.5): 30 % weapon damage and Burning every second. Plus Wisdom, Element Damage and Heal Power.

vadsrijk.klassen.kies.al: You already have your starter weapon. Other weapons: at the trainers, the shop or the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.klassen.kies.onder.knuffelridde: Up front in the fight, handing out cuddles. Wahoog!
vadsrijk.klassen.kies.onder.vadsmagier: The pink magic flows through your pawsies. Chonk!
vadsrijk.klassen.kies.onderkop: You are always all three classes: your class is the weapon in your hand. You can get the other weapons cheaply later.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv4.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at level 50.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_doorboor.uitleg: Your normal shots go through 1 extra enemy (so crossbows go through 2).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_hartjespijl.uit: Snuggle Arrow heals 60 % more and gives your teammate 4 s of Quickpaws. 30 % more damage on enemies.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_ijspijl.uitleg: Your normal shots have a 15 % chance to freeze an enemy for 2 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_jachtinstinct.u: 20 % more damage on enemies below 35 % Chonk. Finish them off!
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_jachtroes.uitle: Every 4th normal shot is a guaranteed crit and fires 2 extra arrows in a fan.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_kleefregen.uitl: Fluff Rain makes enemies Sticky and rains down a 4th wave. Can't be combined with Fire Rain.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_lichtpijl.uitle: Snuggle Arrow marks its target for 6 s: all damage on that target is 15 % higher, your friends' too.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_lichtvoetig.uit: Faster walking and some extra Chonk. Always just out of reach.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_plakbom.uitleg: Roll Flip leaves a slime bomblet behind: enemies within 3 blocks are stuck for 3 s and take 0.8x damage. Roll Flip recharges 2 s faster.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_pluizenmantel.u: After Roll Flip you get a Snuggle Shield of 20 % of your max Chonk for 4 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_poolvacht.uitle: More Dexterity, Chonk and Move Speed. Warm and fast.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_scherpoog.uitle: More crit chance and harder critical hits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_snelle_pees.uit: 15 % Attack Speed: you shoot noticeably faster.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_splinterregen.u: Fluff Rain recharges 1.5 s faster and deals 60 % more damage on frozen enemies.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sporenzoeker.ui: 20 % more damage on creatures with a status (Burning, Spored, Sticky, Stunned or Frozen).
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sterrenoog.uitl: A lot more crit chance and harder critical hits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sterrenzwerm.ui: Star Shot leaves 3 afterglows: each deals 40 % weapon damage to your target.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_valkenoog.uitle: Shots at enemies farther than 12 blocks deal 25 % more damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_vallende_ster.u: Star Shot deals 50 % more damage and gives back 25 % of your ultimate charge.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_vuurregen.uitle: Fluff Rain sets everything under it on fire for 4 s. Can't be combined with Sticky Rain.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_windloper.uitle: Every enemy you help defeat makes Roll Flip ready again right away.

vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.adv.tip: Your job advancement: a new title and a new power.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.punten.tip: Click a node to learn it
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.tab.tip: %s (Lv %s): view this skill tree. ⚔ = your active class (the weapon you last attacked with).
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.wapen.tip: A starter weapon of the %s. You become that class as soon as you attack with it (the skills then start on cooldown).
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.wissel.tip: Every class keeps its own level and skill tree. Weapons belong to a class, armor is shared.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilltip.open_boom: Open your skill tree (K) to see what you've already learned.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.blink: Teleport up to 10 blocks in the direction you're looking (stops neatly before walls). 20 energy, 6 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.knuffelpijl: A heart arrow. If it hits a teammate, they heal 12 % of their Chonk + 0.5x your weapon damage. An enemy takes 2x Pink damage. 25 energy, 7 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.knuffelschi: For 3 s, hits on you only deal 20 %, half bounces back and all enemies within 10 blocks look at you. 30 energy, 15 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.knuffelspro: A big leap forward (about 20 blocks). Every class can do it and you always land softly.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.kussenklap: Swing in a cone in front of you (4.5 blocks) for 1.5x weapon damage with hefty knockback. 20 energy, 3 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.meteoorguh: ULTIMATE: a gigantic guh meteor falls where you aim: 5x Pink damage within 6 blocks, then 6 s of pink fire on that spot.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.pluizenrege: Rains 3 waves of arrows on the spot you aim at (radius 4): each wave deals 0.6x weapon damage to everything under it. 25 energy, 6 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.rolsalto: A backflip away from where you're looking, with a moment of Quickpaws. Your next shot within 5 s is a guaranteed crit. 20 energy, 8 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.roze_vuurba: A slow ball that explodes (radius 3.5) for 2.8x weapon damage in your weapon's element. Fire burns, Nature spores, Water sticks. 25 energy, 4.5 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.sterrenscho: ULTIMATE: charge for 1 s (you walk slower), then a huge 40-block laser arrow straight through everything: 4x weapon damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.stormsprong: Leap to your target (or 8 blocks forward). The landing is a shockwave: 1.3x damage all around. 25 energy, 8 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.vadsbron: A healing circle under your feet (radius 4, 6 s): everyone in it heals 4 % of their Chonk + 0.25x your weapon damage every second. 35 energy, 14 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.skilluitleg.vahoege_plo: ULTIMATE: a giant pillow drops on your target: 3x damage and 3 s stunned within 6 blocks, your group within 8 blocks heals 15 %.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.balie: Here you can reset a class's skill tree for free (once per hour), do your job advancement and get the starter weapons of the other classes.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.boom: Click a node twice to learn it. Of the two variants of your R skill, you pick one.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.gekozen: Your starter weapon is in your backpack. Fluff Hunters and mages: hold down the left mouse button to shoot.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.punt: Every class level gives a skill point in that class. Press K for your skill tree (tabs for the other classes). Choose wisely!
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.welkom: In the little class temple of Camp Snuggle you choose your starter weapon: sword (Snuggle Knight), bow (Fluff Hunter) or staff (Chonk Mage). Your class is always the weapon in your hand.
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.gekregen: You got a starter weapon of the %s! Attack with it to become that class.
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.te_duur: Not enough Chonk Coins: that costs %s.
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.te_hoog: This weapon is level %s. Keep growing a little longer!
vadsrijk.klassen.wapen.verkeerd: This weapon is for a %s. Switch class in the Order temple.
vadsrijk.klassen.wissel.onder: Level %s · your weapons of this class work again
